s: This article explores enabling LLMs to directly manipulate the browser's DOM via WebSocket/SSE, integrating with frameworks like HTMX to create the illusion of AI-driven interactivity. The focus is on making AI a native browser citizen through structured JSON communication and on-demand LLM retraining via system prompts.
sub: Direct DOM manipulation via WebSockets/SSE by LLMs
HTMX proof-of-concept for LLM-driven UI updates
On-demand LLM retraining with system prompts for contextual expertise
Browser as an LLM's native environment for control and interaction
